This '''B1-series battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of a [[Trade Federation]] [[Unidentified Lucrehulk-class battleship (Pantora)|''Lucrehulk''-class Battleship]] during the [[Blockade of Pantora]]. He tracked [[Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Riyo Chuchi]] as they moved through the ship's detention block in search for Chairman [[Notluwiski Papanoida|N. Papanoida's]] kidnapped daughters. The droid then informed [[Sib Canay]] of their presence.<ref name="Sphere">{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}}</ref>
